in_arabic.name: Daumaa
in_arabic.meaning: اسم عربي يعني Mother of the believers
in_arabic.long_meaning: Daumaa هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. In Islamic tradition, Daumaa refers to Aisha bint Abu Bakr, who was a beloved wife of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). This name signifies the strength and courage of the mothers of the believers, inspiring faith and devotion.
